result:
I’d make it harder for people to dehumanize each other.

Not in some neat technical way. Just… remove the ease with which anyone can turn another person into a threat, a statistic, a stranger, or “them.”

If you made it more difficult to imagine another human’s life as less real than your own, a lot of cruelty would stop not because people became virtuous, but because it would become harder to justify doing harm.
